entries.headline: Polls close in Alaska and Hawaii; four more governor races and Virginia's 2nd District are called
entries.body: Polls closed at midnight ET in Hawaii, NBC News reported, and in most of Alaska, where polls close at 8 p.m. Alaska time; the Aleutian Islands close at 1 a.m. ET, the last polling places in the country. NBC News and Fox News each projected the winners of four governor's races: Democrat Hannah Pingree in Maine; Democrat Josh Green, re-elected in Hawaii over Republican Gary Cordery; Democrat David Crowley in Wisconsin over Republican Tom Tiffany; and Republican Mike Mazzei in Oklahoma over Democrat Cyndi Munson. NBC News and Fox News also each projected that Democrat Elaine Luria won Virginia's 2nd District over Republican Jen Kiggans. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Maine's U.S. Senate race has not been called, and calls reported by only one outlet, or contradicted on an outlet's own page, are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026) and the [Alaska](https://www.elections.alaska.gov/) and [Hawaii](https://elections.hawaii.gov/) state election offices.

entries.headline: NBC News, CBS News and Fox News project that Democrats will win the U.S. Senate; Kansas and Iowa Senate races are called
entries.body: NBC News projected at 11:23 p.m. ET, CBS News at about 11:28 p.m. ET and Fox News at about 11:41 p.m. ET that Democrats will win the Senate majority. The scoreboard above counts 17 Senate races called for Democrats, the number the arithmetic in the Senate section says Democrats need from tonight's 35 to reach 51 seats; the count of seats and the winners come from the individual race calls. NBC News, CBS News and Fox News each projected that Democrat Adam Hamilton won Kansas's U.S. Senate race over Republican Sen. Roger Marshall, and that Democrat Josh Turek won Iowa's U.S. Senate race over Republican Ashley Hinson. NBC News and Fox News each projected that Republican Barry Moore won Alabama's U.S. Senate race over Democrat Everett Wess, that Republican Sen. Mike Rounds won South Dakota's U.S. Senate race over independent Brian Bengs, and that Republican Larry Rhoden won South Dakota's governor's race over Democrat Dan Ahlers. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Calls reported by only one outlet so far are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Ohio's and Wyoming's U.S. Senate races and the Texas and Iowa governor races are called
entries.body: NBC News, CBS News and Fox News each projected that Democrat Sherrod Brown won Ohio's special U.S. Senate election over Republican Sen. Jon Husted, with the calls between about 11:05 and 11:17 p.m. ET, and that Democrat Gina Hinojosa won Texas's governor's race over Republican Gov. Greg Abbott, at about 11:04 to 11:13 p.m. ET. NBC News and Fox News each projected that Republican Harriet Hageman won Wyoming's U.S. Senate race over Democrat James Byrd. NBC News and CBS News each projected that Democrat Rob Sand won Iowa's governor's race over Republican Zach Lahn. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Calls reported by only one outlet so far, and any call an outlet's own page contradicts, are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Polls close in California, Oregon and Washington; two more Senate races, two governor races and three House districts are called
entries.body: NBC News reported that polls closed at 11 p.m. ET in California, Oregon and Washington. California counties have up to 30 days to finish counting, so its results will keep changing. NBC News and CBS News each projected that Democrat James Talarico won Texas's U.S. Senate race over Republican Ken Paxton, NBC News at 10:52 p.m. ET and CBS News at about 10:53 p.m. ET. NBC News and Fox News each projected that Democrat Jeff Merkley won Oregon's U.S. Senate race over Republican David Brock Smith. NBC News, CBS News and Fox News each projected that Democrat Amy Acton won Ohio's governor's race over Republican Vivek Ramaswamy, and NBC News and Fox News projected that Democrat Deb Haaland won New Mexico's governor's race over Republican Gregg Hull. NBC News and Fox News also each projected the winners in three House districts, all Democrats: Pennsylvania's 8th, Paige Cognetti; Pennsylvania's 10th, Janelle Stelson; and Texas's 34th, Vicente Gonzalez. Fox News projected at about 10:59 p.m. ET that Democrats will win control of the U.S. House, joining NBC News and CBS News. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Calls reported by only one outlet so far are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Arkansas's U.S. Senate race, Wyoming's governor's race and Pennsylvania's 7th District are called
entries.body: NBC News and Fox News each projected that Republican Sen. Tom Cotton won Arkansas's U.S. Senate race over Democrat Hallie Shoffner, that Republican Eric Barlow won Wyoming's governor's race over Democrat Kenneth Casner, and that Democrat Bob Brooks won Pennsylvania's 7th District over Republican Ryan Mackenzie. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Fox News and CBS News had not reported a House majority call of their own as of their 10:40 p.m. pages, though CBS News projected a Democratic majority earlier; other calls and ballot-measure results reported by only one outlet, or relayed from one outlet by another, are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: NBC News and CBS News project that Democrats will win the U.S. House; New Mexico's Senate and Arkansas's governor races are called
entries.body: NBC News projected at 10:11 p.m. ET, and CBS News at about 10:13 p.m. ET, that Democrats will win a majority in the U.S. House. A majority is 218 of the 435 seats. This page counts House seats only as individual districts are called by two news organizations, so the scoreboard's House count is not a count of the chamber. NBC News said the Senate is not yet projected. NBC News and Fox News each projected that Democrat Ben Ray Luján won New Mexico's U.S. Senate race over Republican Larry Marker, and that Republican Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders won re-election in Arkansas over Democrat Fred Love. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Other projections reported by only one outlet so far are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Polls close in Montana, Nevada and Utah; South Carolina and Tennessee Senate races and New Jersey's 7th District are called
entries.body: NBC News and CBS News reported that polls closed at 10 p.m. ET in Montana, Nevada and Utah. Most Idaho polls also close at 10 p.m. ET, with northern Idaho on Pacific Time closing at 11 p.m. ET. NBC News and CBS News each projected that Democrat Annie Andrews defeated Republican Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina's U.S. Senate race, NBC News at 9:58 p.m. ET and CBS News at about 9:54 p.m. ET. NBC News and Fox News each projected that Republican Sen. Bill Hagerty won Tennessee's U.S. Senate race over Democrat Marquita Bradshaw, NBC News at 9:47 p.m. ET and Fox News at about 9:54 p.m. ET, and that Democrat Rebecca Bennett won New Jersey's 7th District over Republican Tom Kean Jr. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Calls and ballot-measure results reported by only one outlet so far are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Oklahoma's U.S. Senate race is called for Republican Kevin Hern
entries.body: NBC News and Fox News each projected Republican Kevin Hern the winner of Oklahoma's U.S. Senate race over Democrat N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas, NBC News at 9:37 p.m. ET and Fox News at about 9:43 p.m. ET. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. NBC News also reported projected results for several ballot measures and House districts that Fox News and CBS News had not reported by 9:50 p.m. ET; those are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Kentucky's U.S. Senate race and the Georgia and Connecticut governor races are called
entries.body: NBC News and Fox News each projected Republican Andy Barr the winner of Kentucky's U.S. Senate race over Democrat Charles Booker. NBC News, CBS News and Fox News each projected Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms the winner of Georgia's governor's race over Republican Rick Jackson, and NBC News and Fox News each projected Democrat Ned Lamont the winner in Connecticut over Republican Ryan Fazio. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Projections reported by only one outlet so far are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Polls close in 15 more states; five more races are called
entries.body: NBC News and CBS News reported that polls closed at 9 p.m. ET in Arizona, Colorado, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Mexico, New York, North Dakota, South Dakota, Texas, Wisconsin and Wyoming, which in several of them means the remaining counties. NBC News and Fox News each projected the winners of one U.S. Senate race and three governor races: in Colorado's U.S. Senate race, Democrat John Hickenlooper over Republican Mark Baisley; for governor of New York, Democrat Kathy Hochul over Republican Bruce Blakeman; for governor of Florida, Republican Byron Donalds over Democrat David Jolly; and for governor of Rhode Island, Democrat Helena Foulkes. NBC News, CBS News and Fox News each projected Democrat Jamie Ager the winner in North Carolina's 11th District over Republican Jennifer Balkcom. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Projections reported by only one outlet so far, including several New York House districts, are not marked called here. Arizona's counties plan to post first results at about 10 p.m. ET. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Florida's U.S. Senate race is called for Republican Ashley Moody, and Democrat Pia Dandiya in Florida's 22nd District
entries.body: NBC News projected at 8:32 p.m. ET that Republican Sen. Ashley Moody defeated Democrat Angie Nixon in Florida's special U.S. Senate election, and Fox News and CBS News projected the same result shortly afterward, at about 8:35 to 8:40 p.m. ET. It is the first Senate race marked called here for a Republican. NBC News projected at 8:27 p.m. ET, and CBS News at about 8:36 p.m. ET, that Democrat Pia Dandiya won Florida's 22nd District over Republican Casey Askar. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. House and statewide projections reported by only one outlet so far are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: North Carolina and New Hampshire Senate races are called for Democrats; polls close in Arkansas
entries.body: NBC News, CBS News and Fox News each projected that Democrat Roy Cooper defeated Republican Michael Whatley in North Carolina's U.S. Senate race, with the calls at about 8:22 to 8:28 p.m. ET. The same three outlets projected that Democrat Chris Pappas defeated Republican John E. Sununu in New Hampshire's U.S. Senate race, at about 8:13 to 8:20 p.m. ET. NBC News and Fox News also projected Democrat Kathy Castor the winner in Florida's 14th District over Republican Mike Beltran. Fox News shows only relative times, so its call times are approximate. Projections reported by only one of these outlets so far are not marked called here. NBC News reported that polls closed in Arkansas at 8:30 p.m. ET, and the next closings are at 9 p.m. ET. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026).

entries.headline: Ten races are called for Democrats as polls close in the 8 p.m. states
entries.body:
CBS News counted polls closed in 25 states and the District of Columbia by about 8:02 p.m. ET. NBC News and Fox News each projected the following winners, all Democratic; Fox News shows only relative times, so the times of its calls are approximate.

- **U.S. Senate:** Illinois, Juliana Stratton over Republican Don Tracy; Delaware, Chris Coons over Mike Katz; New Jersey, Cory Booker over Justin Murphy; Rhode Island, Jack Reed over Ray McKay; Massachusetts, Ed Markey over John Deaton.
- **Governor:** Illinois, JB Pritzker over Darren Bailey; Maryland, Wes Moore over Dan Cox; Massachusetts, Maura Healey over Mike Minogue; Pennsylvania, Josh Shapiro over Stacy Garrity.
- **U.S. House:** Florida's 25th District, Jared Moskowitz over Scott Singer.

Each state's election office, linked in the [state table](#state-il), publishes the official count. Other projections reported by only one of the two outlets are not marked called here. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763), [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/election-day-results-11-3-2026) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: Georgia's U.S. Senate race is called for Democrat Jon Ossoff
entries.body: NBC News Decision Desk projected at 7:31 p.m. ET that Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff won re-election in Georgia over Republican Rep. Mike Collins, and CBS News projected shortly afterward that he won. That is the second race marked called on this page, each with two news organizations naming the winner. The Georgia Secretary of State's office, linked in the [state table](#state-ga), publishes the official count, and Georgia holds a runoff on Dec. 1 only if no candidate wins a majority. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: Polls close in North Carolina, Ohio and West Virginia
entries.body: Polls in North Carolina, Ohio and West Virginia closed at 7:30 p.m. ET, according to NBC News. Five North Carolina precincts stay open later under the State Board of Elections' extensions, and the board has said it will not publish unofficial results statewide until all polls are closed, with first results expected around 8:15 p.m. The next closings come at 8 p.m. ET in the District of Columbia and in states including Pennsylvania, Michigan and Texas, and in the Florida Panhandle. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and the [North Carolina State Board of Elections](https://www.ncsbe.gov/news/press-releases/2026/11/03/state-board-extends-voting-5-precincts-4-counties).

entries.headline: Virginia's U.S. Senate race is called for Democrat Mark Warner
entries.body: NBC News projected at 7:01 p.m. ET that Democratic Sen. Mark Warner won re-election in Virginia, and CBS News projected shortly afterward that he won. NBC News named Republican Bert Mizusawa as his opponent. This is the first race marked called on this page; it has two news organizations naming the winner. The Virginia Department of Elections, linked in the [state table](#state-va), publishes the official count, and certification comes later. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: Polls close in Georgia, South Carolina, Vermont, Virginia and most of Florida
entries.body: CBS News and NBC News both reported that polls had fully closed in Georgia, Indiana, Kentucky, South Carolina, Vermont and Virginia at 7 p.m. ET, the first states to close for the night. Most Florida polls also close at 7 p.m. ET, but the Panhandle, on Central Time, stays open until 8 p.m. ET. Polls in North Carolina, Ohio and West Virginia close at 7:30 p.m. ET, and North Carolina's State Board of Elections expects its first statewide results around 8:15 p.m. This page has not marked any race called yet; the state election offices linked in the [state table](#state-ga) post the official counts. Sources: [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763).

entries.headline: Polls close in most of Indiana and Kentucky
entries.body: The first polls of the night closed at 6 p.m. ET in the parts of Indiana and Kentucky on Eastern Time. Counties in both states on Central Time close at 7 p.m. ET. Results follow as county election offices report them, and the state election offices linked in the [state table](#state-in) post them. As of the latest entries on the CBS News and NBC News live blogs, which run to about 6 p.m. ET, neither had reported a race call. The next closings are at 7 p.m. ET in Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Vermont and Virginia, and at 7:30 p.m. ET in North Carolina, Ohio and West Virginia. Sources: [Indiana](https://indianavoters.in.gov/) and [Kentucky](https://elect.ky.gov/Pages/default.aspx) state election offices, [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763).

entries.headline: Three Chester County, Pennsylvania, precincts will stay open until 8:30 p.m.
entries.body: Chester County said three precincts will stay open until 8:30 p.m. after machine set-up issues briefly delayed their opening this morning, according to a notice on the county's election information page: Precinct 201 (Easttown 3) at Easttown Township Library in Berwyn, Precinct 210 (Easttown 6) at St. John's Presbyterian Church in Devon and Precinct 244 (East Goshen 2) at Goshen Baptist Church in West Chester. NBC News also reported the extension. Most Pennsylvania polls close at 8 p.m. ET, so these three close 30 minutes later. Sources: [Chester County](https://www.chesco.org/156/Election-Information) and [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763).

entries.headline: North Carolina extends voting at five precincts, and first statewide results move to about 8:15 p.m.
entries.body: The North Carolina State Board of Elections voted to extend voting at five precincts in four counties because of stoppages in voting during the day, according to its Nov. 3 press release. New closing times: South Williams-Tabor City Courthouse in Columbus County, 8:15 p.m.; Como Fire and Rescue Building in Hertford County, 7:55 p.m.; Murfreesboro 1-Murfee Center in Hertford County, 8 p.m.; K8 Holloway Recreation Center in Lenoir County, 8 p.m.; and Wilson City Recreation Building in Wilson County, 7:45 p.m. The board said it will not publish any unofficial results statewide until all polls are closed, and the first results are expected around 8:15 p.m. That replaces the 7:30 p.m. start in the board's earlier reporting timeline. NBC News and CBS News also reported the extensions. Sources: [North Carolina State Board of Elections](https://www.ncsbe.gov/news/press-releases/2026/11/03/state-board-extends-voting-5-precincts-4-counties), [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: Fulton County, Georgia, warns of texts sending voters to the wrong polling places
entries.body: Fulton County officials warned voters about unauthorized text messages claiming that polling places had changed. The county said it did not send them and urged voters to check their polling place on Georgia's My Voter page, CBS News reports, citing the county's statement. NBC News reported that at least three Fulton County voters said they received texts directing them to the wrong polling locations. Sources: [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/) and [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763).

entries.headline: Early voting passes 60 million ballots
entries.body: The University of Florida Election Lab's national tracker counted 60,517,595 early votes as of its 3:10 p.m. ET update: 32,475,167 cast in person and 28,042,428 mail ballots returned. That is about 1.2 million more than its 11:56 a.m. ET count. The lab's data still cover 48 states and the District of Columbia, not Alabama or New Hampshire. Early votes are ballots cast, not results. Source: [University of Florida Election Lab](https://election.lab.ufl.edu/early-vote/2026-early-voting/).

entries.headline: New York officials say a programming update caused the Westchester scanner problem
entries.body: The New York State Board of Elections said the scanner problem in Westchester County stemmed from an update to the county's election programming made after equipment testing, NBC News reports. CBS News, reporting the board's earlier statement at 1:36 p.m. ET, said a late programming change for one municipality's race was not loaded onto Election Day machines elsewhere in the county. The board said every valid vote will be counted and emergency ballot procedures remain in place. NBC News adds that replacement election media is being deployed, with the priority of restoring scanning on at least one machine at each polling location. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: About 1,000 early ballots in Fulton County, Georgia, must be rescanned
entries.body: Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger acknowledged that about 1,000 early-voting ballots in Fulton County must be rescanned because of a technical problem, NBC News reports. CBS News reported at 11:15 a.m. ET that county officials described two ballot-machine problems at two polling locations, persistent paper jams at one and a power issue at the other, and that the county planned a 6:30 p.m. ET election board meeting to approve a rescan or a memory-card transfer, with counting expected between 7 p.m. and 7:30 p.m. CBS News also reported that Raffensperger said he does not expect the problems to delay results. Sources: [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/election-day-2026-midterms/).

entries.headline: Early voting passes 59 million ballots
entries.body: The University of Florida Election Lab's national tracker counted 59,343,704 early votes as of its 11:56 a.m. ET update: 32,021,431 cast in person and 27,322,273 mail ballots returned. Its data cover 48 states and the District of Columbia, not Alabama or New Hampshire, and the lab says not every state updates daily. Early votes are ballots cast, not results. See the [state-by-state early vote totals](/news/how-many-people-voted-early-2026-59-million-early-votes/). Source: [University of Florida Election Lab](https://election.lab.ufl.edu/early-vote/2026-early-voting/).

entries.headline: When Arizona and North Carolina plan to report
entries.body: Arizona counties plan to release their first unofficial results at 8 p.m. Arizona time, Cronkite News and Votebeat report, and Cronkite News adds that state law lets counties post first results one hour after the 7 p.m. close. Arizona does not observe daylight saving time, so 8 p.m. there is 10 p.m. ET. North Carolina's State Board of Elections lists approximate times after its 7:30 p.m. ET close: mail-in absentee results from 7:30 p.m. to about 9 p.m., early voting results from 7:30 p.m. to about 9:30 p.m. and Election Day precinct results from about 8:30 p.m. to midnight, varying by county. The board also scheduled press conferences for 11 a.m. and 4 p.m. ET. Sources: [Cronkite News](https://cronkitenews.azpbs.org/2026/11/03/arizona-2026-midterm-election-live-updates/), [Votebeat](https://www.votebeat.org/arizona/2026/11/02/when-to-expect-election-results-2026-midterms-timing-congress-governor/), [North Carolina State Board of Elections timeline](https://www.ncsbe.gov/results-data/election-results/election-night-reporting-timeline) and [press conference notice](https://www.ncsbe.gov/news/press-releases/2026/11/02/state-election-officials-host-two-press-conferences-election-day).

entries.headline: Ballot scanners in Westchester County, New York, reject paper ballots
entries.body: Scanners at most Westchester County polling sites stopped accepting ballots when polls opened at 6 a.m., according to CBS New York, NBC News, ABC7 New York and The Associated Press (AP), which said the tabulators were not accepting paper ballots. ABC7 New York reports the county Board of Elections cited ballot thickness; NBC News reports the board later said an issue with the paper ballots is keeping machines from accepting them. Voters were told to keep voting, and ballots go into emergency bags that the county says stay secured and monitored. The New York State Board of Elections said emergency ballot procedures are in place. In an 11:09 a.m. ET entry, NBC News reported that the county executive saw no need at that point to extend polling hours. Sources: [CBS New York](https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/ballot-scanner-voting-issue-westchester-county-polls/), [ABC7 New York](https://abc7ny.com/post/election-day-scanner-problem-affects-westchester-polling-sites/20011651/), [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/live-blog/midterm-election-results-2026-news-trump-live-updates-rcna605763) and [AP report as published by a local television station](https://www.wect.com/2026/11/03/election-day-arrives-after-surge-early-voting-with-observers-keeping-close-watch-polls/).

entries.headline: Flooding moves polling places in eight Florida counties
entries.body: NBC News reports at least 21 polling locations were moved across eight Florida counties: Brevard, Broward, Highlands, Indian River, Martin, Okeechobee, Palm Beach and St. Lucie. Brevard County Supervisor of Elections Tim Bobanic moved 11 precincts to four new locations in Melbourne and Palm Bay because of flooding; the county's notice lists polls open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. and says more changes are possible. Voters should confirm their site with their county supervisor of elections; our [Election Day weather and polling place changes story](/news/election-day-2026-weather-forecast-polling-place-changes/) has the National Weather Service outlook. Sources: [Brevard County Supervisor of Elections](https://www.votebrevard.gov) and [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/floods/floods-severe-weather-beset-parts-us-election-day-rcna607186).

entries.headline: Utah lets flood-cut-off San Juan County voters return ballots electronically
entries.body: Lt. Gov. Deidre Henderson signed an emergency order on Monday evening letting San Juan County voters who cannot reasonably reach a drop box or polling place receive and return ballots electronically, a Salt Lake City news outlet reports. Requests are due by 5 p.m. and electronic ballots by 8 p.m. Mountain Time on Nov. 3, and in-person polling places stay open until 8 p.m. AP reported that voters in the county were being allowed to vote electronically on Tuesday, and NBC News also reported the change. Sources: [Salt Lake City news report on the order](https://www.ksl.com/article/51643215/flood-damage-creates-voting-challenges-in-san-juan-county) and [AP report as published by a local television station](https://www.wect.com/2026/11/03/election-day-arrives-after-surge-early-voting-with-observers-keeping-close-watch-polls/).

entries.headline: A Maricopa County vote center closes briefly after a power outage
entries.body: Cronkite News reports that the Laveen Elementary School District Office vote center in Maricopa County closed temporarily early Tuesday because of a power outage. Cronkite News counts it as the third power-related closure in the county, after Paradise Community College and Sunset Canyon School closed temporarily on Monday. NBC News reports that two of the county's 254 polling locations closed temporarily for power problems and reopened. Maricopa County Elections says all 254 locations opened on time Tuesday morning, Cronkite News reports. Arizona polls are open from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. Arizona time. Sources: [Cronkite News](https://cronkitenews.azpbs.org/2026/11/03/arizona-2026-midterm-election-live-updates/) and [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/floods/floods-severe-weather-beset-parts-us-election-day-rcna607186).
